'''Andil''' is a cook in the [[Sun Palace]] of [[Cairhien]].

==Activities==
Mistress [[Beldair]] bellows orders around the kitchen when [[Sashalle Anderly]] and [[Samitsu Tamagowa]] visit the kitchens in the Sun Palace. Andil is one of the cooks she gives orders to.
